notes: Web/a11y remediation on a self-authored React 18 app. The shipped site carries eight real defects spread across shared components (missing labels, wrong role/name on the menu toggle, aside-before-main focus order, no live region on the announcement, colour-only status dots, no skip link, skipped heading level with brand h1, images without alt). The verifier renders pages under jsdom, runs axe-core (WCAG A/AA + best-practice; color-contrast and target-size excluded as unmeasurable under jsdom) asserting zero moderate+ violations, and adds targeted DOM assertions axe cannot see: skip link first, main-before-complementary tab order, role=status/aria-live announcement, textual non-colour-only state, explicit labels (placeholder alone rejected — axe 4.10's label rule accepts placeholder, so this is asserted directly), exactly one h1, every data-declared form control rendered, and every data-declared content image rendered with its data alt. Three hidden pages render unseen data through the same components, so only root-cause component fixes generalize; the oracle repairs the components and proves the visible suite green. Hidden-case generalization is the core difficulty: axe reports 4 of the 8 categories, the other 4 require the targeted contract to be read and implemented. No stateful interaction and no resource pressure: the verifier is a one-shot jsdom render. Medium bucket (12).
